product_summary: Website luminatiles.com (found via direct fetch; search engines returned no usable results for the exact legal name) presents 'Lumina Tile' as a Morbi (Gujarat) tile exporter/curator with corporate office at Office No. 914, The Spire, 150 Ft Ring Road, Rajkot-360004, Gujarat. Declared product lines on the site: Ceramic Wall Tiles 7-9 mm (20x30, 25x37.5, 25x40, 30x45, 30x60, 30x90, 40x80 cm); Ceramic Floor Tiles 7-12 mm (30x30, 40x40, 50x50, 60x60); Porcelain Floor Tiles 8/9/10/12 mm (30x30, 60x60, 60x120, 20x120, 60x180, 80x80, 80x160, 100x100, 120x120, 120x180); Full Body Floor Tiles 8/9/10 mm; Soluble Salt & Double Charge 8-9 mm (60x60); Large Slab Tiles 6/9/12/15/20 mm (80x240, 80x300, 80x320, 120x240, 120x280, 120x320, 160x320); Outdoor Porcelain Tiles 16/20 mm (60x60, 60x90, 60x120, 30x120); Subway Tiles 6-9 mm (8x8 up to 20x20). Surfaces: Glossy, Matt, Carving, Sugar, Lapato, R-10, R-11, Rustic, Punch. HS mapping: porcelain tiles with water absorption <=0.5% by weight -> 690721 (declared, matches the porcelain/full-body/slab core of the range); other porcelain (0.5-10%) -> 690722; ceramic tiles with absorption >10% -> 690723 (the ceramic wall-tile and subway-tile lines, 20x30 to 40x80 cm, are typically in this bracket); ceramic mosaic/cubes -> 690740; other ceramic tiles incl. double-charge/soluble-salt where absorption is not <=0.5% -> 690790. The declared single code 690721 covers only part of the catalogue: the ceramic wall/subway lines and the double-charge/soluble-salt lines are not covered by 690721 alone.
comment: HS verdict: partial. Declared 690721 is correct for the porcelain/full-body/large-slab part of the range but under-declares the catalogue - ceramic wall tiles, subway tiles and soluble-salt/double-charge tiles fall under 690722/690723/690740/690790 depending on water absorption, which the site does not state per SKU. Per project rule 3 the company is kept and the code list is corrected/expanded, not rejected. Role: the site itself states 'Here, everyone calls themselves a manufacturer. We simply know who makes the best and bring it to you' and 'we curate from hundreds of Morbi factories, grade every lot ourselves' - i.e. the company self-describes as a curator/trader of third-party Morbi production, not a manufacturer. Trader signs: no factory address, no kiln/plant details, no production capacity, only a Rajkot corporate office and an export desk; branding is 'Lumina Tile' with a (R) mark. Industry classification 'Строительство и DIY' is a rough fit - the actual line is ceramic/porcelain tile manufacture-and-export (HS chapter 69), not general construction/DIY retail. Product lines missing from the declaration: ceramic wall tiles, subway tiles, outdoor 20 mm porcelain, large-format slabs up to 160x320 cm. All product claims above are from the company's own website only - no customs line was available in this task, so the entire range is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. The site's claims of '23+ export countries', '35+ sizes', '95%+ client retention' and 'India's fastest growing tile company' are marketing statements, not verified. Note also that the exact legal name 'LUMINA TILE LLP' could not be corroborated on the site (it brands itself 'Lumina Tile' with a (R) mark and does not show an LLPIN); the link between the website and the registered LLP entity is therefore unconfirmed. No registry, revenue or customs research was performed per role scope; those fields are null.
